title: use_quillt_pkgdown() should add the vignette infrastructure too
description:
I think from https://github.com/rstudio/rticles/pull/412 as some files were missing  (https://github.com/rstudio/rticles/pull/412/commits/8f81237c23aabf2e713833f3e65eea5536162fb8) that `use_quillt_pkgdown()` is not complete. 

As we are creating the vignette from a template
https://github.com/rstudio/quillt/blob/f6c6729a389419d3964f1e0fcfd14ac610e9c541/R/templates.R#L93-L97

we don't use `usethis::use_vignette()`, which leads to missing part in the package when no vignettes are already there. 

This should be improved.

title: Do we really need "Browse source code at " on the right sidebar ?
description:
Asking because we will always have the github icon on the navbar with this theme. 

Example of this link: https://pkgs.rstudio.com/rmarkdown/

This could remove one link on the side. 

But maybe it is automatically inserted by pkgdown... 🤔

title: Make the CRAN version stand out on the main index page ?
description:
Currently, with the way we are working on R Markdown ecosystem, we will only have one website per repo showing the **dev version** of the package. So the number in the header is the one from the dev version. 

Usually, there is a CRAN badge but pkgdown (or our theme ?) put those badges at the bottom. So you need to scroll : https://pkgs.rstudio.com/rmarkdown/index.html

Wouldn't it be interesting to have the badges stand out more ? 
Shortening the content of right column sidebar is also an option obviously. 

I am also thinking of having r-universe badges (https://ropensci.org/blog/2021/06/22/setup-runiverse/#adding-badges-and-user-instructions) on the README, this would be interested to have them on the main page.

title: use in-header.html?
description:
Since you are using dev pkgdown anyway, do you think that instead of using a template for head.html you could put all your overrides in in-header.html? See https://pkgdown.r-lib.org/dev/news/index.html#pkgdown-development-version-unreleased 

I had a look at your head.html and I'm not sure you only add things, though. E.g. you directly write the GA tag which you couldn't do via in-header.html.
